statement: ∀ (s t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), (KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.S t f) ↔ KdVPlan.MemH s f) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.S t f) = KdVPlan.hn s f
proof:
intro s t f
have hnorm : ∀ k, ‖KdVPlan.S t f k‖ = ‖f k‖ := by
  intro k
  simp [KdVPlan.S, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal]
constructor
· simp only [KdVPlan.MemH, hnorm]
· simp only [KdVPlan.hn, hnorm]
